problem_statement: ToolManager currently applies a Gemini-safe global tool-name rewrite while OpenAI and Gemini services independently adapt names and schemas. The approved M6.2 slice must make canonical skill IDs internal and confine provider-specific adaptation to one shared boundary without changing provider behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical dotted skill IDs remain internal.
OpenAI and Gemini provider names normalize at the adapter boundary.
OpenAI forced tools, Gemini history, and executor alias fallback remain compatible.
Do not add loop extraction, transport classes, streaming, OAuth, OpenRouter product work, provider policy, or Git actions.
local_validation_commands: python -m py_compile backend/llm_providers/shared/tool_call_adapter.py backend/services/tool_manager.py backend/llm_providers/openai/service.py backend/llm_providers/gemini/service.py backend/llm_providers/shared/utils.py
cursor_prompt_contract: Inspect and edit only allowlisted files. Implement the one bounded ToolCallAdapter slice, run only the listed checks, do not commit, and return concise JSON-compatible output.
